beat: Sunday morning, paint preparations, unexpected Chotu visit and lunch invitation

lines.original: Sunday morning, with John and Pappu leaving to see John's parents, Dhika was checking out Pappu's room to resume the painting work... The coat of primer was done and hopefully.... with the help on Chotu, she can resume next coat she wanted... post which she has to paint the patterns on top of it.
lines.local: Sunday subah John aur Pappu, John ke parents se milne ja rahe the. Dhika ne Pappu ka kamra check kiya taaki painting phir shuru kar sake. Primer ka coat ho chuka tha; umeed thi ki Chotu ki madad se next coat lagakar upar patterns bana sakegi.

lines.original: John's parents live in a small town, couple of hours from here and with them out of the house... Dhika had the whole day free to finish all her household works, without any hindrance.
lines.local: John ke parents yahan se kuch ghante door chhote shehar mein rehte hain. Dono ke jaane ke baad Dhika ke paas ghar ka kaam bina rukawat niptaane ke liye poora din tha.

lines.original: She was busy with works all morning... cleaning and cooking and washing - she was spinning all over like a Top toy and doing so, she looked like a woman who walked in hot sun for hours..... sweating and dusting all over.
lines.local: Subah bhar safai, cooking aur washing mein woh lattoo ki tarah ghoomti rahi; paseene aur dhool se aisi lag rahi thi jaise ghanton tez dhoop mein chali ho.

lines.original: Disgusted of herself...she ran into the bathroom, longing for a cold shower.... When the cold water hit her body, a chill shiver ran through her body........... Giggling to herself like a child.... she started washing herself.....
lines.local: Apni haalat se pareshan hokar woh thande shower ke liye bathroom bhaagi. Thanda paani lagte hi kaamp uthi; bachchon ki tarah khud se hansti hui nahaane lagi.

lines.original: Ding Dong.....
lines.local: Ding dong—doorbell.

lines.original: Chotu: Didi.... open the door....
lines.local: Chotu: Didi, darwaza kholo!

lines.original: After a minute........
lines.local: Ek minute baad...

lines.original: Ding Dong....
lines.local: Ding dong!

lines.original: Chotu: didiiiiii...open..............
lines.local: Chotu: Didiiii, kholo!

lines.original: After 2 minute.......
lines.local: Do minute baad...

lines.original: Ding Dong... Ding Dong.... Ding Dong......
lines.local: Ding dong, ding dong, ding dong!

lines.original: Chotu: helloooooo.... Di.....
lines.local: Chotu: Helloooo, Di...

lines.original: Before he could finish the sentence.....the door opened suddenly and Dhika grabbed his hands....... and pulling him inside, she shut the door at the same speed as she opened it..
lines.local: Uska vaakya poora hone se pehle darwaza achanak khula. Dhika ne Chotu ke haath pakadkar use andar kheench liya aur utni hi tezi se darwaza band kar diya.

lines.original: Chotu: didi...... oh,....hehe....why..... why are you standing like this...
lines.local: Chotu: Didi... oh... hehe... aap aise kyun khadi ho?

lines.original: Dhika was dripping wet from top to bottom.... standing in just a towel, a little portion of her boobs spilling out and with an angry look on her face.......
lines.local: Dhika sir se pair tak paani se bheegi thi, sirf towel pehne thi, towel ke kinaare se breasts ka thoda hissa nikal raha tha, aur chehre par gussa tha.

lines.original: Dhika: uhnnn... because a stupid kept shouting from the other side of the door, while I was bathing..
lines.local: Dhika: Uhnn... kyunki ek gadha mere nahaate waqt darwaze ke us paar se chillaata jaa raha tha!

lines.original: Chotu: oh,.... hehe.... sorry
lines.local: Chotu: Oh... hehe... sorry.

lines.original: Dhika: Donkey....wait here....saying, she went into her bedroom and closed the door...
lines.local: Dhika: Gadhe, yahin ruko! Woh apne bedroom mein gayi aur darwaza band kar liya.

lines.original: She came back a few minutes later wearing a loose T shirt and a short skirt, to be comfortable while painting.
lines.local: Kuch minute baad painting mein comfortable rehne ke liye loose T-shirt aur chhoti skirt pehenkar lauti.

lines.original: Dhika: yes sir... tell me...
lines.local: Dhika: Haan sir, bataiye...

lines.original: Chotu: hehe... nothing didi... I was free and thought we could finish some painting and so came..
lines.local: Chotu: Hehe, kuch nahi didi. Main free tha, socha thodi painting khatam kar lein, isliye aa gaya.

lines.original: Dhika: awh... that's so sweet of you dear. Today, I was thinking to start by myself as you would be on leave and I didn't want to disturb you today.
lines.local: Dhika: Aww, kitne sweet ho dear! Main toh soch rahi thi aaj khud hi start karoon, tumhari chhutti hai aur disturb nahi karna chahti thi.

lines.original: Chotu: it is not problem didi... anyways, I was alone at home since mom went to hometown....
lines.local: Chotu: Koi problem nahi didi; waise bhi mummy hometown gayi hain, main ghar par akela tha.

lines.original: Dhika: oh..is it... then we can paint together...and today you can have lunch with me... she said smiling....
lines.local: Dhika: Achha! Phir saath painting karenge. Aaj lunch bhi mere saath karna. Woh muskurayi.

lines.original: Chotu: sure didi... I missed your tasty food.. hehe
lines.local: Chotu: Zaroor didi, aapke tasty khaane ko miss kiya tha, hehe.
